notes: Every source morpheme and every target token is accounted for; nothing is added and nothing unrepresented.
s008 אֵת takes 'unto' under rule 16's first family: the English 'give thanks' reaches its object only through that preposition, and no other morpheme in the clause licenses it.

The temple chain is rendered attributively ('thy holy temple'), so rule 28 governs and the construct keeps only 'temple' while the rectum takes 'holy'; rule 19's 'of' does not arise. The same holds for כָּל־שִׁמְךָ → 'all thy name', where the ASV writes no relational word for the chain.
Both עַל units take their own written 'for'; two prepositions are written in the Hebrew, so nothing is distributed under rule 25.
